source.name: EuroTeams Basketball: Patty Mills x LDLC ASVEL 2026-27 EuroLeague Jersey | Men’s
source.note: The page's front view of the jersey (https://euroteams-basketball.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/asvel-euroleague-domicile-8-mills-avant-EL.png) shows 'LDLC ASVEL' across the chest; BeBasket's photos of the 2026-27 Betclic Élite shirts (https://cdn.bebasket.fr/resources/images/blog/patty-mills-c-florentin-brere-1f1b6834-e121-6fbc-840a-17fb87466946.jpg, https://cdn.bebasket.fr/resources/images/blog/asvel-noir-myles-cale-1f1b6841-983b-68cc-962f-f36ba2d57644.jpg) show the same. LDLC has been the club's naming sponsor since 2018.

source.name: L'Auxiliaire: L'Auxiliaire renforce son engagement aux côtés de LDLC ASVEL et affirme son identité lyonnaise (communiqué de presse)
source.quote: Partenaire depuis 2022, L'Auxiliaire devient, à compter de ce dimanche 22 mars, Partenaire Premium et sponsor maillot de l'équipe professionnelle
source.note: Jersey sponsor from 22 March 2026; the release adds: 'L’Auxiliaire bénéficiera d’une visibilité maximale lors des rencontres de Betclic ELITE'. For 2026-27, BeBasket's roundup of the season's Betclic Élite shirts (22 September 2026, https://www.bebasket.fr/tous-les-maillots-de-betclic-elite-pour-la-saison-2026-2027) shows L'Auxiliaire across the lower front of the white shirt (https://cdn.bebasket.fr/resources/images/blog/patty-mills-c-florentin-brere-1f1b6834-e121-6fbc-840a-17fb87466946.jpg). It isn't on the EuroLeague version (https://euroteams-basketball.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/asvel-euroleague-domicile-8-mills-avant-EL.png).

source.name: EuroTeams Basketball: Patty Mills x LDLC ASVEL 2026-27 EuroLeague Jersey | Men’s
source.quote: Show your support for Villeurbanne with the official 2026–2027 home jersey designed by Adidas.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. The page also lists 'Kit Provider: Adidas'; its front view (https://euroteams-basketball.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/asvel-euroleague-domicile-8-mills-avant-EL.png) shows the adidas logo on the chest.

summary: 'LDLC ASVEL', the club's name with its naming sponsor LDLC, is across the chest; L'Auxiliaire is on the lower front in Betclic Élite games (jersey sponsor since 22 March 2026); adidas makes the kit. Not marked complete: BeBasket's photos of the 2026-27 Betclic Élite shirts (https://www.bebasket.fr/tous-les-maillots-de-betclic-elite-pour-la-saison-2026-2027) also show Swile, Adéquat and DCB International on the chest and Visiativ on the shorts, which have no record here yet, and no cited source shows the back of the Betclic Élite shirt. The EuroLeague version carries only the club's name, the adidas logo and the league's patch.
